remarks:
Very motivated seller! Welcome Home to this beautifully refreshed property offering a wonderful blend of modern updates, functionality and comfortable living. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this home is move-in ready and offers plenty of space both inside and out. 

The heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen, featuring brand-new custom cabinetry, a deep kitchen sink, new bronze faucets, stylish backsplash, functional island, and custom coffee bar- creating a space that is as practical as it is inviting. The bathroom has also been tastefully updated with custom cabinetry, double sinks and new faucets. 

Throughout the home, fresh paint, new flooring, and new light fixtures create a clean, cohesive and welcoming atmosphere. The sunroom is a standout feature, with large windows that fill the room with natural light and provide a peaceful place to relax while taking in the surrounding properties. 

The property features beautiful landscaping, several fruit trees, a white fence along the front and a large peaceful yard with plenty of room for outdoor enjoyment. There is an artesian well and a brand new water pump.

The roundabout driveway provides easy access and ample parking. While the two car garage and additional storage shed offer plenty of room for vehicles, tools, equipment and outdoor belongs. 

With many updates, flexible living spaces, spacious sunroom, and beautiful outdoor setting, this property offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy a refreshed and comfortable home with plenty of character and functionality.
